component.name: Nurul Islam
component.summary: Holy Quran, Prayer Times, Tajweed & Hanafi Fiqh Companion
Qur'oni Karim, Namoz vaqtlari, Muallimi Soniy va Hanafiy Fiqhi hamrohi
Священный Коран, время намаза, Таджвид и Ханафитский фикх

description.p: Nurul Islam is a comprehensive, ad-free, offline-capable Islamic companion designed with authentic Hanafi scholarship and multilingual support (Uzbek Latin, Uzbek Cyrillic, English, and Russian).
Key features include:

ul.li: The Holy Quran (114 Surahs) with Arabic Mushaf script, Uzbek/Russian/English translations, tafsir, word-by-word breakdown, and reciter audio
Accurate Prayer Times and Ramadan Suhoor/Iftar calendar with Uzbekistan regional, district, and village precision
Muallimi Sani and Tajweed Trainer: 10 progressive lessons (Ahmad Hodiy Maqsudiy method), interactive audio Qaida practice board, 5 Makhraj articulation zones, and color-coded Tajweed
Hifz Memorization Trainer for 18 prayer Surahs and Duas with 3-stage word-hiding memory practice
Everyday Hanafi Fiqh Q&A Encyclopedia, 8 Real-Life Hanafi Guides, 40 Fards, Selected Ayahs, Hadiths, and Morning/Evening Adhkar
99 Names of Allah (Asma ul-Husna) with audio, solo quiz, and live 1v1 quiz battle
Digital Tasbih counter, Qazo prayer tracker, Zakat calculator, Nearby Masjids map, and Verified Masjid Support (Ehson & Hashar)

description.p: Upgraded the Islamic Library into a 41-book Hybrid Full-Length Library (700+ chapters, 3,800+ pages): 16 core classics bundled 100% offline plus 25 full-length cloud volumes (Sahih al-Bukhari, Sahih Muslim, Tirmidhi, Abu Dawud, Muwatta, Alchemy of Happiness, Gulistan, Al-Hidayah, Kitab al-Tawhid, and more) that automatically cache offline on first open, powered by instant per-chapter swipe pagination.
Cleaned up generated PNG share cards for Quran Ayahs, Hadiths, Duas, Wisdom, and Library book passages by removing all background star watermarks and sparkle glyphs.

Upgraded the Islamic Library into a full-screen zero-scroll swipe book reader: every page automatically paginates to fit the screen without vertical scrolling, turns smoothly by swiping left or right (touch, mouse drag, or keyboard arrows) with a live page-peel effect, and automatically saves reading progress with Next/Prev and Mark Read buttons removed.

Bundled 168 offline Arabic MP3 pronunciation clips (including Mishary Al-Afasy recitation for Al-Fatihah and Al-Ikhlas) so every Listen button in the Muallimi Sani and Tajweed Trainer plays reliably on Android, Linux Desktop, and Web; redesigned the Islamic Library into an authentic physical bound book experience with hardcover shelf volumes, stacked parchment pages, spine shadow, classical serif typography, drop caps, and swipe page-turning.

Added two major sections: 24/7 Live Quran Radio with 16 verified streaming channels, automatic failover, favorites, and a persistent background mini-player; and the Classical Islamic Library (Kutubxona) featuring 13 curated public-domain Hanafi and Movarounnahr classics with a distraction-free offline e-reader, Sepia paper mode, reading progress tracker, and PNG quote cards.

Added 1-tap Prayer Notification bell toggle on the Home prayer banner using the signature Nurul Islam chime, eliminated loading spinners on local tabs for instant navigation, redesigned the Tasbih with royal honey-amber and emerald-jade gemstone beads, highlighted saved Quran ayahs with direct Back return to Profile, enlarged the header app logo, and replaced the off-season Ramadan counter with year-round Khatm progress.

Redesigned the Profile and Settings screens for clarity: moved Settings to a dedicated top-right gear button inside the green Profile banner, placed Saved Ayahs directly on Profile, upgraded Prayer Alerts with a modern collapsible sliding toggle switch, and removed unnecessary technical clutter.
Added a dedicated, calm Nurul Islam prayer notification chime across Android notification channels and Desktop alerts, with Chime, System, and Silent modes plus instant sound preview in Settings.

Major quality and reliability release: persistent cross-tab Quran audio with floating mini-player and Media Session controls on Linux Desktop and Web, iOS Safari Qibla compass permission support, 100% offline self-hosted DM Sans and Lora fonts, one-tap JSON user progress Backup and Restore, resilient React ErrorBoundary recovery, automatic scroll-to-top on tab switches, direct ayah jump from Profile bookmarks, honest Web settings, and elimination of localStorage quota bloat.

Upgraded the Nurul Islam web edition into a full responsive web application with widescreen desktop navigation, full-screen mobile browser layout, shareable deep-link URLs, and a localized download hub for PWA, Android APK, and Fedora RPM.

Bundled all 114 Quran Surahs (Arabic Uthmani and Uzbek Alouddin Mansur) locally for instant offline text loading without network delay, added offline Surah MP3 audio downloads on Linux Desktop and Web, and extended modern Nurul Islam PNG Quote Card sharing to Quran Ayahs, Hadiths, Zikr, and Duas.

Redesigned the shareable Scholars and Wisdom PNG Quote Card with modern Nurul Islam Day and Night emerald-and-gold palettes, elevated card framing, subtle Rub el Hizb watermarks, and the Nurul Islam app icon footer.
Added Muhammad Sharif Gulkhani (Zarbulmasal parables and proverbs) and enriched the Scholars and Wisdom library to 9 Movarounnahr masters and 83 verified, source-cited works.
Upgraded Juma Mode with a fully customizable Friday Sunnah checklist featuring dedicated Men and Women Hanafi presets, custom user tasks, reordering, and item visibility toggles.
Streamlined Scholars and Wisdom with a compact Daily Hikmat banner and added native PNG Quote Card saving and sharing on Android and Linux Desktop.

Added Scholars and Wisdom (Allomalar va Hikmatlar) featuring 48 curated works and commentaries from 8 Movarounnahr masters (Ahmad Yasawi, Bahauddin Naqshband, Alisher Navoi, Sufi Allahyar, Abdulkhaliq Ghijduwani, Imam al-Bukhari, Imam al-Maturidi, and Burhanuddin al-Marghinani), Daily Wisdom spotlight, bookmarks, and shareable PNG quote cards.

Added native in-app and mandatory self-updater with PolicyKit authentication and automatic relaunch for RPM desktop installations, alongside 60% smaller startup bundle, zero-spinner tab prefetching, and gapless next-ayah audio pre-buffering.

Performance upgrade: reduced initial entry bundle by 60% for faster cold launch, added idle and hover/touch background tab prefetching for instant navigation, and added gapless next-ayah audio pre-buffering for Quran and Hifz playback.
Added 10-lesson Muallimi Sani and Tajweed trainer, Everyday Hanafi Fiqh Q&A encyclopedia, Seerah and 25 Prophets stories, and customizable Home screen feature grid.
